pull_request.title: chore(deps): bump moment to 2.31.0 in the asset-monitoring Cloud Function source
pull_request.body:
## In plain terms

The source for the Cloud Function that watches for risky IAM changes pins the `moment` date library at 2.30.1, which has an open advisory. This moves it to 2.31.0. Three alerts close.

## What changes

One line in each of three identical `package.json` files: the `gcp-org` stack, and the Go and TypeScript foundation examples. They move together so the copies stay the same.

Upstream `terraform-example-foundation` still pins 2.30.1, so this is a deliberate step ahead of upstream.

## What merging this does

**Nothing is deployed, now or later.** The function is not switched on here: `enable_scc_resources_in_pulumi` is not set in the `gcp-org` production config, so the stack does not create it. The `gcp-org` preview on this PR confirms it: 0 changes, 230 unchanged.

That is why this is `chore(deps)` and not `fix`: a release would deploy nothing. If the function is switched on later, it will be built from the patched source.

The two example copies are exported to their mirror repos.

## How it was checked

The function makes one `moment` call: `moment.utc(str).valueOf()`. I ran it on both versions with seven inputs (plain UTC, fractional seconds, nanosecond precision, an offset, a space-separated form, garbage, empty). Results were identical.

## Correction

An earlier version of this description said a later `gcp-org` release would replace the Cloud Function. That was wrong; I had not checked whether the function was enabled.

Part of issue #2622.
